meta.name: GCS-SQL-Tool
meta.description: Lesende SQL-Konsole für den CMS-SQLite-Bestand. Nur für die aktive SuperAdmin-Rolle; der Server erzwingt readOnly. Mit Reports für Karteikästen, Lernaktivität, Belohnungen und Spielnutzung.

objects.name: Hinweis
objects.text: Links einen Report wählen, dann Ausführen. Reports zeigen gespeicherte Bestände; Ziehungszähler sind noch nicht erfasst. Belohnungspunkte gelten je Vereinbarung. Maximal 500 Ergebniszeilen.

records.name: Report: Karteikästen je Kind
records.description: Aktive Kind-Karten, einschließlich Fach 6. Stapelvorlagen und gelöschte Karten zählen nicht.
records.sql:
SELECT p.id AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, count(c.record_key) AS gesamt,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_1,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_2,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_3,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_4,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_5,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_6,
sum(CASE WHEN c.record_key IS NOT NULL AND (json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') IS NULL OR json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5,6)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ohne_fach
FROM people p LEFT JOIN flashcards c ON c.childId=p.id AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.active')=1
WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY kind, kind_id;

records.name: Report: Stapel im Karteikasten
records.description: Tatsächlich importierte Kind-Karten je Herkunftsstapel und Fach; eigene Karten bilden eine eigene Gruppe.
records.sql:
SELECT c.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind,
json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId') AS stapel_id,
CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId') IS NULL THEN 'Eigene Karten / ohne Stapel' ELSE coalesce(json_extract(d.payload,'$.name'),'Nicht mehr verfügbarer Stapel') END AS stapel,
count(*) AS gesamt, sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_1,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_2,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_3,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_4,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_5,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fach_6,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') IS NULL OR json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ohne_fach
FROM flashcards c JOIN people p ON p.id=c.childId LEFT JOIN cardDecks d ON d.id=json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId')
WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.active')=1 GROUP BY c.childId, json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId') ORDER BY kind, stapel;

records.name: Report: Karten nach Fachgebiet
records.description: Aktive Kind-Karten nach Fachgebiet und Thema, mit bereits gelernten Karten.
records.sql:
SELECT c.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, coalesce(json_extract(c.payload,'$.subject'),'Ohne Fachgebiet') AS fachgebiet,
coalesce(json_extract(c.payload,'$.topic'),'Ohne Thema') AS thema, count(*) AS karten,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box')=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gelernt
FROM flashcards c JOIN people p ON p.id=c.childId WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.active')=1
GROUP BY c.childId, fachgebiet, thema ORDER BY kind, fachgebiet, thema;

records.name: Report: Lernpunkte und gebuchte Versuche
records.description: Nur ursprüngliche Karten-Lernereignisse. Keine Ziehungsstatistik: nicht gebuchte Versuche sind nicht enthalten. Gesamtlernstand bleibt unabhängig von Belohnungen.
records.sql:
SELECT p.id AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, coalesce(json_extract(p.payload,'$.cardPointMode'),'progress') AS zaehlregel,
count(e.record_key) AS gebuchte_lernereignisse,
coalesce(sum(json_extract(e.payload,'$.learningDelta')),0) AS netto_lernpunkte,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(e.payload,'$.toBox')>json_extract(e.payload,'$.fromBox') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aufstiege,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(e.payload,'$.fromBox')>1 AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.toBox')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rueckfaelle,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(e.payload,'$.verification')='reported' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS selbst_gemeldet,
max(json_extract(e.payload,'$.occurredAt')) AS letzte_lernaktivitaet
FROM people p LEFT JOIN performanceLedger e ON e.childId=p.id AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.cardLearningEvent')=1
WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY kind, kind_id;

records.name: Report: Lernaktivität pro Tag (30 Tage)
records.description: UTC-Tage aus gespeicherten Ereignissen; ohne Aktivität gibt es keine Zeile. Aufstiege und Rückfälle sind keine vollständige Richtig/Falsch-Quote.
records.sql:
SELECT e.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, date(json_extract(e.payload,'$.occurredAt')) AS tag_utc,
count(*) AS gebuchte_lernereignisse, sum(coalesce(json_extract(e.payload,'$.learningDelta'),0)) AS netto_lernpunkte,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(e.payload,'$.toBox')>json_extract(e.payload,'$.fromBox') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aufstiege
FROM performanceLedger e JOIN people p ON p.id=e.childId WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.cardLearningEvent')=1
AND datetime(json_extract(e.payload,'$.occurredAt')) >= datetime('now','-30 days')
GROUP BY e.childId, tag_utc ORDER BY tag_utc DESC, kind;

records.name: Report: Belohnungen je Begleitung
records.description: Erfüllte und offene Kartenbelohnungsansprüche getrennt. Punkte je Vereinbarung, niemals sponsorübergreifend als einzigartige Lernpunkte addieren.
records.sql:
SELECT s.id AS begleitung_id, s.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind,
json_extract(sp.payload,'$.name') AS sponsor, json_extract(s.payload,'$.status') AS begleitstatus,
json_extract(c.payload,'$.agreementId') AS vereinbarung_id,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.status')='fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS erfuellte_runden,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.status')='fulfilled' THEN coalesce(json_extract(c.payload,'$.consumedPoints'),0) ELSE 0 END) AS belohnte_punkte,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.status')='earned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS erreicht,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.status')='requested' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS angefragt,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.status')='released' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uebergabe_ausstehend,
sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.status')='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS storniert
FROM rewardClaims c JOIN sponsorships s ON s.id=c.sponsorshipId JOIN people p ON p.id=s.childId JOIN people sp ON sp.id=s.sponsorId
WHERE json_extract(c.payload,'$.rewardMode')='cardRounds' OR json_extract(c.payload,'$.snapshot.rewardMode')='cardRounds'
GROUP BY s.id, json_extract(c.payload,'$.agreementId') ORDER BY kind, sponsor;

records.name: Report: Offene Belohnungen
records.description: Alle erreichten, angefragten und freigegebenen Ansprüche einschließlich beendeter Begleitungen; noch nicht erfüllt.
records.sql:
SELECT c.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, json_extract(sp.payload,'$.name') AS sponsor,
json_extract(c.payload,'$.entitlementKey') AS anspruch, json_extract(c.payload,'$.status') AS status,
json_extract(c.payload,'$.snapshot.rewardText') AS belohnung, json_extract(c.payload,'$.snapshot.pointsTarget') AS punkteziel,
json_extract(c.payload,'$.createdAt') AS erreicht_am, json_extract(c.payload,'$.fulfillmentReportedAt') AS uebergabe_gemeldet_am
FROM rewardClaims c JOIN people p ON p.id=c.childId LEFT JOIN people sp ON sp.id=json_extract(c.payload,'$.sponsorId')
WHERE json_extract(c.payload,'$.status') IN ('earned','requested','released') ORDER BY erreicht_am, kind;

records.name: Report: Spielnutzung (30 Tage)
records.description: Sitzungen je Kind und Spiel, unabhängig von heutigen Katalogfreigaben. UTC-Zeitfenster.
records.sql:
SELECT ps.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, ps.gameId AS spiel_id, json_extract(g.payload,'$.name') AS spiel,
count(*) AS sitzungen, sum(CASE WHEN json_extract(ps.payload,'$.status')='ended' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beendet,
max(json_extract(ps.payload,'$.startedAt')) AS letzter_start
FROM playSessions ps JOIN people p ON p.id=ps.childId LEFT JOIN games g ON g.id=ps.gameId
WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 AND datetime(json_extract(ps.payload,'$.startedAt')) >= datetime('now','-30 days')
GROUP BY ps.childId, ps.gameId ORDER BY sitzungen DESC, kind, spiel;

records.name: Report: Bestätigte Eltern je Kind
records.description: Bestätigte, aktive Elternbeziehungen; Kinder ohne bestätigte Eltern sind sichtbar.
records.sql:
SELECT p.id AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, count(g.record_key) AS bestaetigte_eltern,
group_concat(json_extract(ep.payload,'$.name'),', ') AS eltern
FROM people p LEFT JOIN guardians g ON g.childId=p.id AND json_extract(g.payload,'$.status')='confirmed'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM people parent WHERE parent.id=g.guardianId AND json_extract(parent.payload,'$.active')=1)
LEFT JOIN people ep ON ep.id=g.guardianId WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY kind;

records.name: Report: Karten mit Datenproblemen
records.description: Aktive Kind-Karten mit ungültigem Fach oder fehlendem Herkunftsstapel. Ohne-Stapel-Karten sind zulässig.
records.sql:
SELECT c.id AS karte_id, c.childId AS kind_id, json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS kind, json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') AS fach,
json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId') AS stapel_id,
CASE WHEN json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') IS NULL OR json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) THEN 'Ungültiges Lernfach' ELSE 'Herkunftsstapel fehlt' END AS hinweis
FROM flashcards c JOIN people p ON p.id=c.childId LEFT JOIN cardDecks d ON d.id=json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId')
WHERE json_extract(p.payload,'$.kind')='child' AND json_extract(p.payload,'$.active')=1 AND json_extract(c.payload,'$.active')=1 AND (json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') IS NULL OR json_extract(c.payload,'$.box') NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) OR (json_extract(c.payload,'$.sourceDeckId') IS NOT NULL AND d.id IS NULL))
ORDER BY kind, karte_id;

records.name: Lernen: Alle Tabellen
records.sql: SELECT name AS tabelle FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;

records.name: Lernen: Tabellenstruktur (Beispiel roles)
records.sql: SELECT sql AS definition FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='roles';

records.name: Lernen: Felder aus payload lesen
records.sql: SELECT id, json_extract(payload,'$.name') AS name, json_extract(payload,'$.active') AS aktiv FROM people ORDER BY ordinal;

records.name: Lernen: JOIN — Spiele pro Bereich
records.sql: SELECT json_extract(ar.payload,'$.name') AS bereich, json_extract(ga.payload,'$.name') AS spiel, json_extract(ga.payload,'$.file') AS datei FROM grants g JOIN games ga ON ga.id=g.gameId JOIN areas ar ON ar.id=g.areaId ORDER BY bereich;

records.name: Lernen: JOIN — Kinder und Begleitpersonen
records.sql: SELECT json_extract(k.payload,'$.name') AS kind, json_extract(e.payload,'$.name') AS begleitperson FROM guardians g JOIN people k ON k.id=g.childId JOIN people e ON e.id=g.guardianId;

records.name: Lernen: JOIN — Rollen mit Personennamen
records.sql: SELECT json_extract(p.payload,'$.name') AS person, r.role, r.areaId, json_extract(r.payload,'$.active') AS aktiv FROM roles r JOIN people p ON p.id=r.personId ORDER BY person;

records.name: Lernen: GROUP BY — Karten je Leitner-Fach
records.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.box') AS fach, count(*) AS karten FROM flashcards GROUP BY fach ORDER BY fach;

records.name: Lernen: Spielsitzungen pro Tag
records.sql: SELECT substr(json_extract(payload,'$.startedAt'),1,10) AS tag, count(*) AS sitzungen FROM playSessions GROUP BY tag ORDER BY tag DESC;

records.name: Lernen: Audit — letzte Aktivitäten
records.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.at') AS zeit, json_extract(payload,'$.actor') AS akteur, json_extract(payload,'$.action') AS aktion FROM cms_audit ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 50;

records.name: Lernen: UNION — Zeilen je Tabelle
records.sql: SELECT 'people' AS tabelle, count(*) AS zeilen FROM people UNION ALL SELECT 'areas', count(*) FROM areas UNION ALL SELECT 'flashcards', count(*) FROM flashcards UNION ALL SELECT 'playSessions', count(*) FROM playSessions UNION ALL SELECT 'performanceLedger', count(*) FROM performanceLedger;

records.name: Lernen: WHERE — ungelesene Benachrichtigungen
records.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.type') AS typ, recipientPersonId, json_extract(payload,'$.createdAt') AS erstellt FROM notifications WHERE json_extract(payload,'$.readAt') IS NULL;

records.name: Lernen: Ledger — gebuchte Lernpunkte
records.sql: SELECT childId, json_extract(payload,'$.cardSubject') AS thema, json_extract(payload,'$.learningDelta') AS delta, json_extract(payload,'$.fromBox') AS von_fach, json_extract(payload,'$.eventId') AS ereignis FROM performanceLedger ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 50;

records.name: Lernen: Zugänge — Hash bleibt im payload
records.sql: SELECT personId, username FROM cms_credentials ORDER BY username;

records.name: Lernen: Temporäre Raumzutritte
records.sql: SELECT personId, roomId, sessionId, json_extract(payload,'$.active') AS aktiv FROM temporaryRoomAccess ORDER BY ordinal DESC LIMIT 50;

records.name: Lernen: Karteikarten mit Antwortvorschau
records.sql: SELECT id, json_extract(payload,'$.question') AS frage, json_extract(payload,'$.box') AS fach, json_extract(payload,'$.active') AS aktiv FROM flashcards ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 100;

records.name: Lernen: Parties und Einladungen
records.sql: SELECT p.id AS party, json_extract(p.payload,'$.status') AS status, json_extract(i.payload,'$.invitedPersonId') AS eingeladen FROM parties p LEFT JOIN gameInvitations i ON i.sessionId=p.id;
